---
# ============================================================
# RNA-seq heatmap for ER+ pILC Bionano subgroup
# Input: log2TPM matrix
# Main figure: same WES/IMPACT breast/cancer gene panel
# Optional figure: top variable expressed genes
# Output: /ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Grant/RNASeq/
# ============================================================
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
})

graphics.off()
gc()

# ============================================================
# Paths
# ============================================================

tpm_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/4_Count_file_pILC/Max_TPM/tpm_matrix_pILC_log2TPM.txt"

clinical_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Grant/pILC_ClinicoPathological_details.csv"

out_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Grant/RNASeq"
table_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# ER+ Bionano subgroup
# 10 samples total; RNA-seq expected for 9 of 10
# ============================================================

grant_samples_10 <- c(
  "TP05-232",
  "TP05-726",
  "TP07-626",
  "TP08-2202",
  "TP11-1516",
  "TP11-1780",
  "TP12-880",
  "TP13-820",
  "TP14-385",
  "TP15-M509"
)

# Same WES/IMPACT breast/cancer gene panel
breast_genes <- c(
  "ERBB2", "FGFR1", "NF1", "GNAS", "PAK1", "PIK3CA", "PTEN",
  "AKT1", "GATA3", "ESR1", "FOXA1", "ARID1A", "TBX3", "MYC",
  "MCL1", "MAP3K1", "RECQL4", "RARA", "CCND1", "CDH1", "TP53",
  "BRCA1", "RICTOR", "FAT1", "JAK3", "CIC", "ARID2", "ERBB3"
)

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================

parse_percent_value <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan")] <- NA_character_

  is_less_than <- grepl("^<", x)

  val <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", x))
  )

  val[is_less_than & !is.na(val)] <- val[is_less_than & !is.na(val)] / 2

  return(val)
}

clean_grade_status <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)

  out <- x
  out[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan") | is.na(x)] <- "Unknown"

  return(out)
}

zscore_rows <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  z[z > 2.5] <- 2.5
  z[z < -2.5] <- -2.5
  z
}

# ============================================================
# Read RNA-seq log2TPM matrix
# ============================================================

cat("Reading TPM matrix:\n", tpm_file, "\n\n")

tpm_dt <- fread(
  tpm_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(tpm_dt)) {
  stop("Input TPM matrix must contain a column named 'Gene'.")
}

tpm_dt[, Gene := trimws(as.character(Gene))]

# Convert expression columns to numeric
sample_cols_all <- setdiff(colnames(tpm_dt), "Gene")

for (cc in sample_cols_all) {
  tpm_dt[, (cc) := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(get(cc)))]
}

# If duplicate gene symbols exist, keep mean expression per gene
tpm_dt <- tpm_dt[
  !is.na(Gene) & Gene != "",
  lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
  by = Gene,
  .SDcols = sample_cols_all
]

# ============================================================
# Identify RNA-seq available subgroup samples
# ============================================================

rna_available_samples <- grant_samples_10[
  grant_samples_10 %in% colnames(tpm_dt)
]

rna_missing_samples <- setdiff(grant_samples_10, rna_available_samples)

cat("========== RNA-seq availability in ER+ Bionano subgroup ==========\n")
cat("Total ER+ Bionano samples:", length(grant_samples_10), "\n")
cat("RNA-seq available:", length(rna_available_samples), "\n")
cat("RNA-seq missing:", length(rna_missing_samples), "\n\n")

cat("RNA-seq available samples:\n")
print(rna_available_samples)

cat("\nRNA-seq missing samples:\n")
print(rna_missing_samples)

rna_availability <- data.table(
  Sample = grant_samples_10,
  RNAseq_available = grant_samples_10 %in% rna_available_samples
)

fwrite(
  rna_availability,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_n10_RNAseq_sample_availability.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# ============================================================
# Read clinical annotation
# Same bottom annotation style as WES/IMPACT ComplexHeatmap
# ============================================================

clinical_dt <- fread(
  clinical_file,
  sep = ",",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN", "N/A")
)

clinical_dt[, Sample_key := trimws(as.character(Sample))]

clinical_dt[, tumor_cellularity_pct := parse_percent_value(`tumor_cellularity (%)`)]

clinical_dt[, pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct := parse_percent_value(
  `pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)`
)]

clinical_dt[, TILs_pct := parse_percent_value(`TILs (%)`)]

clinical_dt[, Grade_clean := clean_grade_status(`Grade/Differentiation-Desc`)]

clinical_plot_dt <- unique(
  clinical_dt[
    ,
    .(
      Sample_key,
      tumor_cellularity_pct,
      pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct,
      TILs_pct,
      Grade_clean
    )
  ],
  by = "Sample_key"
)

sample_clin_dt <- data.table(
  Tumor_Sample_Barcode = rna_available_samples,
  Sample_key = rna_available_samples
)

sample_clin_dt <- merge(
  sample_clin_dt,
  clinical_plot_dt,
  by = "Sample_key",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

sample_clin_dt <- sample_clin_dt[
  match(rna_available_samples, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
]

fwrite(
  sample_clin_dt,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_RNAseq_sample_order_and_clinical_annotation.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

clinical_anno_df <- data.frame(
  `Tumor cell. (%)` = sample_clin_dt$tumor_cellularity_pct,
  `Pleomorphic (%)` = sample_clin_dt$pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct,
  `TILs (%)` = sample_clin_dt$TILs_pct,
  Grade = sample_clin_dt$Grade_clean,
  check.names = FALSE
)

rownames(clinical_anno_df) <- rna_available_samples

grade_cols <- c(
  "Grade I" = "#A6CEE3",
  "Grade II" = "#33A02C",
  "Grade III" = "#1F78B4",
  "Cell type not determined" = "#E31A1C",
  "Unknown" = "#BDBDBD"
)

observed_grade_levels <- unique(na.omit(clinical_anno_df$Grade))
observed_grade_levels <- observed_grade_levels[observed_grade_levels != ""]

missing_grade_levels <- setdiff(observed_grade_levels, names(grade_cols))

grade_cols_local <- grade_cols

if (length(missing_grade_levels) > 0) {
  extra_grade_cols <- hcl.colors(length(missing_grade_levels), palette = "Dark 3")
  names(extra_grade_cols) <- missing_grade_levels
  grade_cols_local <- c(grade_cols_local, extra_grade_cols)
}

clinical_anno_cols <- list(
  `Tumor cell. (%)` = colorRamp2(
    c(0, 50, 100),
    c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#08306B")
  ),
  `Pleomorphic (%)` = colorRamp2(
    c(0, 50, 100),
    c("#F7FCF5", "#74C476", "#00441B")
  ),
  `TILs (%)` = colorRamp2(
    c(0, 30, 100),
    c("#FFF5F0", "#FB6A4A", "#67000D")
  ),
  Grade = grade_cols_local
)

bottom_clin_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  ` ` = anno_empty(
    height = unit(0.2, "mm"),
    border = FALSE
  ),
  df = clinical_anno_df,
  col = clinical_anno_cols,
  na_col = "grey90",
  which = "column",
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_name_rot = 0,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  simple_anno_size = unit(0.22, "cm"),
  gap = unit(c(0.4, rep(0.5, ncol(clinical_anno_df) - 1)), "mm"),
  show_annotation_name = c(
    ` ` = FALSE,
    `Tumor cell. (%)` = TRUE,
    `Pleomorphic (%)` = TRUE,
    `TILs (%)` = TRUE,
    Grade = TRUE
  ),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    `Tumor cell. (%)` = list(title = "Tumor cell. (%)"),
    `Pleomorphic (%)` = list(title = "Pleomorphic (%)"),
    `TILs (%)` = list(title = "TILs (%)"),
    Grade = list(title = "Grade")
  )
)

# ============================================================
# Main heatmap: same WES/IMPACT breast/cancer gene panel
# ============================================================

panel_genes_present <- breast_genes[
  breast_genes %in% tpm_dt$Gene
]

panel_genes_missing <- setdiff(breast_genes, panel_genes_present)

cat("\n========== Breast/cancer panel genes in RNA-seq matrix ==========\n")
cat("Panel genes present:", length(panel_genes_present), "\n")
cat("Panel genes missing:", length(panel_genes_missing), "\n\n")

cat("Missing panel genes:\n")
print(panel_genes_missing)

fwrite(
  data.table(
    Gene = breast_genes,
    Present_in_RNAseq_TPM_matrix = breast_genes %in% tpm_dt$Gene
  ),
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_RNAseq_WES_IMPACT_panel_gene_presence.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

expr_panel_dt <- tpm_dt[
  Gene %in% panel_genes_present,
  c("Gene", rna_available_samples),
  with = FALSE
]

# Preserve original panel gene order
expr_panel_dt[, Gene := factor(Gene, levels = panel_genes_present)]
expr_panel_dt <- expr_panel_dt[order(Gene)]
expr_panel_dt[, Gene := as.character(Gene)]

expr_panel_mat <- as.matrix(expr_panel_dt[, ..rna_available_samples])
rownames(expr_panel_mat) <- expr_panel_dt$Gene

expr_panel_z <- zscore_rows(expr_panel_mat)

fwrite(
  data.table(Gene = rownames(expr_panel_mat), expr_panel_mat),
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_RNAseq_WES_IMPACT_panel_log2TPM_matrix.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

fwrite(
  data.table(Gene = rownames(expr_panel_z), expr_panel_z),
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_RNAseq_WES_IMPACT_panel_rowZ_matrix.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

cell_size_mm <- 4   # smaller: 2.5 or 2.0; larger: 3.5 or 4.0

heatmap_body_width_mm  <- max(45, cell_size_mm * ncol(expr_panel_z))
heatmap_body_height_mm <- max(55, cell_size_mm * nrow(expr_panel_z))

plot_width  <- max(8, min(18, heatmap_body_width_mm / 25.4 + 5.0))
plot_height <- max(8, min(20, heatmap_body_height_mm / 25.4 + 4.8))

expr_col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2.5, 0, 2.5),
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
)

# Distance between title and heatmap body
ht_opt$TITLE_PADDING = unit(c(2, 10), "mm")

ht_panel <- Heatmap(
  expr_panel_z,
  name = "Row Z-score",
  col = expr_col_fun,

  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_order = rna_available_samples,

  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_side = "left",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),

  column_title = paste0(
    "ER+ pILC Bionano Subgroup: RNA-seq Expression\n",
    "WES/IMPACT Gene Panel | genes: ", nrow(expr_panel_z),
    " | samples: ", ncol(expr_panel_z)
  ),
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),

  width = unit(heatmap_body_width_mm, "mm"),
  height = unit(heatmap_body_height_mm, "mm"),

  bottom_annotation = bottom_clin_ha,

  column_gap = unit(0.05, "mm"),
  row_gap = unit(0.05, "mm"),

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Expression\nrow Z-score",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
  )
)

pdf_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "ERpos_Bionano_RNAseq_heatmap_WES_IMPACT_gene_panel_rowZ.pdf"
)

png_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "ERpos_Bionano_RNAseq_heatmap_WES_IMPACT_gene_panel_rowZ.png"
)

pdf(pdf_file, width = plot_width, height = plot_height)

draw(
  ht_panel,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = FALSE,
  padding = unit(c(4, 22, 6, 4), "mm")
)

dev.off()

png(
  filename = png_file,
  width = plot_width,
  height = plot_height,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)

draw(
  ht_panel,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = FALSE,
  padding = unit(c(4, 22, 6, 4), "mm")
)

dev.off()

cat("\nSaved main RNA-seq panel heatmap:\n")
cat(pdf_file, "\n")
cat(png_file, "\n")

# ============================================================
# Optional heatmap: top variable genes within RNA-seq available samples
# This is useful as supplemental/internal feasibility QC
# ============================================================

top_n_variable <- 50

expr_all_mat <- as.matrix(tpm_dt[, ..rna_available_samples])
rownames(expr_all_mat) <- tpm_dt$Gene

gene_var <- apply(expr_all_mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)

gene_var_dt <- data.table(
  Gene = rownames(expr_all_mat),
  variance = gene_var
)

gene_var_dt <- gene_var_dt[
  is.finite(variance)
][
  order(-variance)
]

top_variable_genes <- head(gene_var_dt$Gene, top_n_variable)

expr_var_mat <- expr_all_mat[top_variable_genes, , drop = FALSE]
expr_var_z <- zscore_rows(expr_var_mat)

fwrite(
  gene_var_dt,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_RNAseq_all_genes_variance_rank.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

fwrite(
  data.table(Gene = rownames(expr_var_z), expr_var_z),
  file = file.path(table_dir, paste0("ERpos_Bionano_RNAseq_top", top_n_variable, "_variable_genes_rowZ_matrix.tsv")),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# ============================================================
# Optional heatmap: top variable genes
# Cell size and plot size must be defined BEFORE Heatmap()
# ============================================================

cell_size_mm <- 4.0

heatmap_body_width_mm_var <- max(40, cell_size_mm * ncol(expr_var_z))
heatmap_body_height_mm_var <- max(45, cell_size_mm * nrow(expr_var_z))

plot_width_var <- max(7, min(16, heatmap_body_width_mm_var / 25.4 + 5.0))
plot_height_var <- max(7, min(18, heatmap_body_height_mm_var / 25.4 + 4.8))

# Control distance between title and heatmap body
ht_opt$TITLE_PADDING = unit(c(2, 10), "mm")

ht_var <- Heatmap(
  expr_var_z,
  name = "Row Z-score",
  col = expr_col_fun,

  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_side = "left",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),

  column_title = paste0(
    "ER+ pILC Bionano Subgroup: Top ",
    top_n_variable,
    " Variable RNA-seq Genes\n",
    "samples: ", ncol(expr_var_z)
  ),
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),

  width = unit(heatmap_body_width_mm_var, "mm"),
  height = unit(heatmap_body_height_mm_var, "mm"),

  bottom_annotation = bottom_clin_ha,

  column_gap = unit(0.05, "mm"),
  row_gap = unit(0.05, "mm"),

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Expression\nrow Z-score",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
  )
)

pdf_file_var <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  paste0("ERpos_Bionano_RNAseq_heatmap_top", top_n_variable, "_variable_genes_rowZ.pdf")
)

png_file_var <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  paste0("ERpos_Bionano_RNAseq_heatmap_top", top_n_variable, "_variable_genes_rowZ.png")
)

pdf(pdf_file_var, width = plot_width_var, height = plot_height_var)

draw(
  ht_var,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = FALSE,
  padding = unit(c(4, 22, 6, 4), "mm")
)

dev.off()

png(
  filename = png_file_var,
  width = plot_width_var,
  height = plot_height_var,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)

draw(
  ht_var,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = FALSE,
  padding = unit(c(4, 22, 6, 4), "mm")
)

dev.off()

cat("\nSaved optional top-variable-gene RNA-seq heatmap:\n")
cat(pdf_file_var, "\n")
cat(png_file_var, "\n")
```
